material.acceptance_criteria: The clock is off only for target_os = "unknown"; the wasip3 guest records buckets.
material.description: rust/crates/sim/src/tick.rs:44-52 cfg(target_arch = wasm32) returns None; the comment says only wasm32-unknown-unknown traps on Instant::now. The wasip3 guest has a clock, so its tick costs are dropped. Also COSTS is a process-wide static shared by every Sim in one process.
